images.title: The product must stay two digits
images.purpose: Shows that PQ × 8 = RS forces PQ to be at most 12, and 12 × 8 = 96 is the answer.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One puzzle line at the top, the solution below it, and one crossed out try.
images.exact_structure: Top, large: PQ × 8 = RS with letters in teal (#0072B2). Middle: 12 × 8 = 96 in a green (#009E73) outlined box. Bottom, smaller, grey (#6B7280): 13 × 8 = 104 with one vermilion (#D55E00) line struck through it and the words too big. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: The size of the product limits the choices, leaving 12 × 8 = 96.
images.description: Shows that PQ × 8 = RS forces PQ to be at most 12, and 12 × 8 = 96 is the answer.
images.context: 13 × 8 = 104 has three digits; 10 and 11 repeat digits.
images.teaching_notes: Struck through try is drawn in grey.

image_decisions.why: Puzzle, answer and the bound in one view show how the product's size narrows the search.
